info.title: Janus API
info.description:
Assessment of the persistence, bioaccumulation, toxicity, carcinogenicity, mutagenicity, reproductive toxicity and endocrine disruption of a chemical, from its SMILES.

A calculation is always a job: the request is accepted immediately, the progress can be followed on the event stream of the job, and the results are fetched once it completes.

The service runs locally inside the desktop application and has no authentication on purpose.

Streams the progress of a job as server-sent events.

A running calculation cannot actually be stopped, so the events of a cancelled job simply end.

200.description: The stream of progress events, each carrying the state of the job

get.description: Tells whether the models are loaded. Jobs submitted before that are accepted but wait.

molecules.description: the molecules to assess; at least one

metabolism.description: whether to generate and assess the metabolites of the input molecules. Defaults to false: the metabolism module is currently broken, see the README.

workflows.description: the workflows to run; when null or empty, all of them are run

id.description: an optional identifier; when absent the engine assigns "Mol n"

smiles.description: the SMILES of the molecule, mandatory

experimentalValues.description: optional experimental values, keyed by the identifiers returned by GET /api/metadata (bcf, logp, p_soil, p_water, p_sediment, tox, carc, muta, repro, ed). When a workflow finds an experimental value for its property, it uses it instead of the prediction and reports full reliability.

MoleculeRequestDto.description: One input molecule of a job.

error.description: a short description of the problem

details.description: the specific issues, e.g. one entry per invalid molecule

ErrorDto.description: The body returned for a request that could not be accepted.

name.description: the label of the value, as produced by the workflow

value.description: the value, always rendered as text by the workflow itself

AdditionalValueDto.description:
One of the intermediate values a workflow exposes besides its own prediction (single model
 predictions, experimental values, applied rules).

startedAt.description: when the calculation started, null while queued

finishedAt.description: when the calculation ended, null while queued or running

results.description: the assessment of every molecule, null until the job completes

log.description: the diagnostic messages produced during the calculation

error.description: the reason of the failure, only set when the status is FAILED

JobDto.description: The state of a job, as returned by POST /api/jobs and GET /api/jobs/{id}. Results and log are only populated once the job has finished.

phase.description: the phase being executed, e.g. "PERSISTENCE workflow"

processedMolecules.description: the molecules processed so far within this phase

totalMolecules.description: the molecules this phase will process

JobProgressDto.description:
The progress of a running job.

The engine runs the workflows one after the other over the whole dataset, so the progress is reported per phase: processedMolecules restarts from zero on every phase change.

num.description: the 1-based position of this result within the job

smiles.description: the SMILES of the molecule, as read by the engine

valid.description: whether the molecule could be processed

metabolite.description: whether this result describes a metabolite of another molecule

parentNum.description: the num of the parent molecule, null if not a metabolite

metabolites.description: the num of the metabolites generated from this molecule

scoreVPvB.description: the vPvB index, null when it could not be calculated

scorePBT.description: the PBT index, null when it could not be calculated

scoreSVHC.description: the SVHC index, null when it could not be calculated

MoleculeResultDto.description:
The complete Janus assessment of one molecule: the seven workflow results plus the three aggregated regulatory indices.

When the metabolism calculation is enabled, the results of a job also contain the metabolites of the input molecules; those are linked to their parent through parentNum and metabolites, which refer to the num field.

predictionClass.description: the qualitative assessment, or "-" when not available

prediction.description: the quantitative assessment, in the unit of the property

reliability.description: the reliability of the assessment, in [0, 1]

additionalValues.description: the intermediate values, in the order the workflow produced them

WorkflowResultDto.description:
The outcome of a single workflow for one molecule.

All numeric fields are null when the workflow could not produce a value: the -999999 sentinel used internally never reaches the API.

key.description: the key to use in the experimentalValues of a molecule

description.description: what the value is, including its unit

experimentalKeys.description: the accepted keys for the experimental values of a molecule

MetadataDto.description: The static description of what the service can calculate, returned by GET /api/metadata so that a client does not have to hardcode it.

id.description: the value to use in the workflows field of a job request

label.description: the human readable name of the workflow

ready.description: whether the engine finished loading the models

error.description: the reason why the engine could not be initialized, if it failed

HealthDto.description: The state of the calculation engine, returned by GET /api/health. Loading the models takes a while at startup, so a client should wait for ready before submitting jobs.
